description: How would you describe Tesla in 5 words? I'm sure there's some creative answers out there 👀
transcript: If you had to write an ad headline for Tesla with only five words, what would those five words be? I think it would be better cars for less money. The quality of car that you get when you get a Tesla in comparison to what you pay is far above the competition in many instances. If you try to get that quality of car five years ago from a different brand, you've been playing way more. I think that's the No. 1 thing.
